Officer's narrative
On a weekday afternoon in Baytown, Texas, Driver 2 was stopped in a traffic lane when the vehicle operated by
Driver 1 struck the rear of Driver 2's car. Driver 1 is identified as the named insured on the policy for the vehicle.
Passenger was also present in Driver 1's vehicle, and both the responding officer and statements from the scene
confirm that Passenger was seated inside at the time of impact. Driver 1 reported neck strain and was evaluated at
the scene. The reported injury is consistent with the type and force of a rear-end collision of this kind. Photographs
taken at the scene show damage to both vehicles that is largely consistent with the described impact, and they
confirm several details given by the drivers. No independent witnesses were located. No prior damage to either
vehicle is known to the reporting officer. Both vehicles were driven from the scene after exchanging information, and
no citations were issued at the time of this report.
